pkgmetadata.longdescription: laya is a fast, non-autoregressive "System 1" decision engine: a small transformer-based model that makes calibrated probabilistic decisions in a single forward pass instead of token-by-token generation. It builds on pytorch, transformers and the huggingface hub model registry, and ships optional integrations (fastapi serving, onnx export, langchain/crewai adapters) as upstream extras.
